title: ID0368981-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / P8 170000767] Not whitelist the IP of external Modbus controller
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Charger will not whitelist the IP of the external Modbus controller.
Root cause: Modbus IP
Solution: On site intervention
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: 08/07/2024 (Yes)
